disagreements: Empirical depth error: pipeline box_noise 85 ppm vs my random-phase-box std 45 ppm (my single-box-noise/sqrt(N) = 42 ppm, per-event-scatter/sqrt(N) = 72 ppm). Hence empirical SNR 10.0 (pipeline) vs 20.0 (mine). The depth itself agrees; the pipeline's error is the more conservative.
Odd/even: same sense and size (odd shallower by ~120-180 ppm) but 2.0 sigma under my errors vs 0.7 sigma under the pipeline's.
Duration: pipeline holds 4.5 h fixed; my free fits give 4.1 h (BLS box), 4.3 h (box-SNR scan), 4.84 h (trapezoid T14, T23/T14 = 0.70).

Per-year depths are not fully consistent: 2011 = 691 +- 72 ppm vs 2012 = 1067 +- 82 ppm (chi2 13.0 for 4 dof about the weighted mean); the pipeline's event quartiles show the same drift (642 -> 992 ppm). Removing the Q13-edge outlier event (epoch 28, 2268 +- 349 ppm, 0.40 d after a gap) lowers 2012 to 896 +- 81 ppm and the chi2 to 4.5.
Period: 35.58770 (mine, BLS refine) vs 35.58726 (pipeline): differ by 4.4e-4 d, which is 1.0 sigma of my timing-fit period error.
